git diff f2e52393~1..HEAD of instruction.md and environment/instructions (word diff, to compare with the version hosted QC flagged)
evidence: I read instruction.md cold. It is three short first-person paragraphs: the motivation (instruction.md:1 'I often paste a long one-line experiment, format it, make changes in several places, and then run it beside the source. I want to keep the versions that work without losing a draft when another tab saves first'), a pointer to the six notes and seed (line 3, 'there is no starter app to finish'), and how the person starts and checks it (line 5). It has no numbered acceptance list, no shall/must table, no feature matrix and no build recipe. It names no framework, file layout or endpoint list. A grep for list markers across instruction.md and all six notes found no bullets or numbered items. Each note is a few prose paragraphs. The notes the hosted QC flagged are now written by the requester with reasons: behaviour.md:13 'I keep the browser's network panel open while I debug, so please make saves and restores ordinary HTTP requests from the page that I can see there', which replaces the earlier bare 'Send saves and restores as ordinary HTTP requests'. Also behaviour.md:13 'My connection drops now and then, so if the same restore request arrives again...', ui.md:5 'I like seeing numbered lines and where I am', ui.md:9 'I use multiple carets a lot', ui.md:15 'I paste a lot of compact one-line experiments' and ui.md:17 'I sometimes check things on my phone'. The word diff from f2e52393~1 to HEAD shows that the passive spec wording ('Support normal typing...', 'Offer Find...', 'Provide Format document...', many 'must') became requests ('I need Find with...', 'should'). Modal counts in the frozen notes: ui.md has 0 'must' and 8 'should'; behaviour.md has 1 'must' and 10 'should'. Residual Note, not a defect: ui.md and behaviour.md are still dense with edge-case precision, for example the Tab/outdent rule for a selection ending at the start of the next line (ui.md:7), Replace all when the replacement contains the search text (ui.md:11), and the per-interaction five-second budget (behaviour.md:5). Each is phrased as a user's experience of a real editor or runtime, and a developer specifying a custom editor plausibly writes like this. integration.md (port 0.0.0.0:3000, DB_PATH, the symlink rule) and policy.md ('Use the public behaviour in these notes as the contract') are the runtime contract that row 4 requires; they are not a build recipe. Counterexample test: there is no plausible broken or conforming app whose grade depends on this row; it concerns prompt register only. Looseness: for row 1 nothing became looser. Ctrl/Cmd+A and the backwards Find wrap are now stated publicly, which is clearer. Outside this row, security.md:3 now requires blocking only the playground's own address under localhost/127.0.0.1. The earlier text also required fetches to 'outside addresses' to fail, so the public isolation requirement is narrower; rows 25 and 6 should confirm this is intended. The hashes of the frozen instruction.md and all six notes match the live projects/colderwater-playground-devtools files. No raw-evidence-index.json was present in the run folder; this row needs no runtime measurement.
